parts.text: The life you want…
is going to cause you embarrassment.
That is the price.
Asking out that girl you like?
Embarrassing.
Starting that business?
Everybody's gonna laugh.
Posting content?
You're gonna feel like a fucking clown.
But here's what they don't tell you.
That five seconds of embarrassment…
is so much better than being fifty years old,
looking back at a life full of regret…
because you were too scared to take the chance.
Every single person you look up to…
at some point risked looking like a fucking idiot.
And yet… they did it anyway.
You think they weren't scared?
They just put their dreams above their fucking ego.
Stop protecting your pride…
and start chasing your fucking life.
